feature_name: Pin Click Version for MkDocs Live Reload
description: Pin the Click dependency to a specific version to ensure MkDocs live reload functionality works correctly. This will prevent potential compatibility issues when Click updates and maintain consistent behavior across development environments.
functional_requirements: Pin the Click package to version 8.1.7 in the project dependencies
Update the lock file to reflect the pinned Click version
Ensure the pinned version doesn't break existing MkDocs functionality
Maintain compatibility with other dependencies in the project
